title: Education
desc: Under the Right To Education Act (RTE) 2009, education is a fundamental right for children aged 6-14. Emyris Foundation focuses on addressing educational gaps in underserved areas, investing in physical facilities, and ensuring school access is available, acceptable, and adaptable.
bullets: School infrastructure building in remote sectors
Scholarships and learning grants for marginalized groups
Dedicated special needs educational programs
Awareness drives to decrease student dropout rates

title: Healthcare
desc: With a population over 1.4 Billion in India, healthcare access is a major challenge. In support of the government's 'Ayushman Bharat' initiative, Emyris Foundation focuses on providing primary healthcare, screenings, health camps, and diagnostic support directly to rural doorstep locations.
bullets: Standalone diagnostics and outpatient clinics
Telemedicine connecting rural patients to specialists
Preventative health camps (Diabetes, Hypertension)
Vaccine and child nutrition campaigns

title: Livelihood
motto: From Struggle to Strength: Elevating Lives
desc: Sustainable livelihoods build resilient communities. We focus on enhancing employability by identifying skill gaps in underprivileged groups, conducting training bootcamps, and providing placement support to break poverty traps.
bullets: Communication skills & soft skills training
Digital literacy and technology awareness
Mock interviews and professional resume building
Placement facilitation & post-placement counseling

title: Women Empowerment
motto: Her Rights, Her Choices, Her Voice
desc: Investing in women unlocks our full human capital. Through Emyris's 'Shiksha Hi Surakhya' program, we combine safety-focused initiatives (like self-defense), local mentorship, mobile learning resources, and educational incentives to empower women and young girls.
bullets: Mobilizing local leaders to champion girls' education
Community workshops and cultural events ('Gram Utsav')
Self-defense training and basic rights education
Peer mentorship linking successful community women

title: Farmer's Connect
desc: Agriculture is the backbone of the nation. Emyris Farmer's Connect creates practical linkages for organic farming, soil testing, market economics, and diversified cropping to combat farmer distress and promote ecological sustainability.
bullets: Workshops in agricultural fields and colleges
Real-time advice through mobile apps and platforms
Model demonstration farms for eco-farming
Organic cultivation training & soil conservation methods
